page_title: MON 3-1 NAN | Monaco v Nantes 13/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+4' Ansu Fati (Monaco) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Anthony Lopes has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Ansu Fati (Monaco) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
90+1' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
85' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:2.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
83' Fabien Centonze (Nantes) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Jordan Teze (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Eric Wattellier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' A pass by Simon Adingra (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
80' 49:51 – the ratio of ball possession.
78' Substitution. Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) has come on for Ali Youssef.
76' The substitution has been made. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) has replaced Vanderson.
76' Here is a change. Folarin Balogun is going off and Sebastien Pocognoli gives the last tactical orders to Mika Biereth (Monaco).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Denis Zakaria as he is replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
74' 11:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
72' Monaco take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
71' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

69' Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Eric Wattellier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' Ahmed Kantari decides to make a substitution. Francis Coquelin will be replaced by Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Remy Cabella will be replaced by Ignatius Ganago (Nantes).
66' That will be all from Mohamed Kaba who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Johann Lepenant (Nantes).

65' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is given a second yellow card for his behaviour. He said too much to the referee and Eric Wattellier sent him off. One can only wonder what was going on his head. He has weakened his team.
64' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

63' Matthis Abline (Nantes) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
63' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' Lamine Camara has picked up an injury and is replaced by Ansu Fati (Monaco).
62' Deiver Machado (Nantes) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Nantes have a corner.
60' Nantes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
57' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Monaco will take a corner kick.
55' The Nantes players are exchanging some short passes.
51' Vanderson (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
48' Nantes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
48' Nantes take the free kick with a short pass.
46' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn is equal to it and makes an easy save.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
46' Ahmed Kantari makes a half-time substitution. Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) comes on in place of Abakar Sylla.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Abakar Sylla (Nantes) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just over the bar.
45+4' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Nantes out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
45+4' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' 3 - 1 Goal! Deiver Machado produces a great pass that finds Fabien Centonze (Nantes) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 3:1.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lamine Camara (Monaco) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Mamadou Coulibaly replaces him.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
41' Simon Adingra (Monaco) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
38' Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
35' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
32' Eric Wattellier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lamine Camara (Monaco).

30' 3 - 0 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin displays great vision and sends a pass to Denis Zakaria (Monaco), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 3:0.
28' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Aleksandr Golovin tees up Simon Adingra (Monaco) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Anthony Lopes.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Simon Adingra (Monaco), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
25' A loose ball is pounced on by Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert and makes a comfortable save.
22' A poor finish by Folarin Balogun (Monaco) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
20' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

20' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
19' A quickly taken corner by Monaco.
19' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
18' Good team movement sets up Simon Adingra (Monaco) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
16' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' Monaco take a short corner kick.
13' A cross into the box from Vanderson (Monaco) is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) was too forceful with his tackle and Eric Wattellier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

9' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
8' Monaco get a corner.
8' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
6' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
4' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Dangerous play by Caio Henrique (Monaco). Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
